deduplication.canonicalization_rule: PARI PDF/resource page, Census catalogue references, CiNii, NDL, library holdings and any mirrors are manifestations/catalogue records of one 2004 Atlas identity, not independent sources.
deduplication.dependency_rule: Secondary works quoting Census-1991 Mundari/Munda totals are dependent on the Census/Atlas and must not count as independent corroboration of those totals.

rights_access_cultural_controls.note: Public access and Government copyright do not establish unrestricted redistribution or cultural permission. Aggregate Census language statistics are not treated as participant-level consent.
